messages:
OpsLead: FYI team — scheduled GPU pool drain + backfill window tomorrow 2026-03-24 02:00-04:00 UTC. Target: us-west-2 primary GPU pool. Expected: temporary capacity reroute to us-west-2b, short eviction spikes for non-pinned Dedicated nodes. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-backfill-2026-03-24
Infra-Oncall: Im taking oncall for the window. Plan: 10-min canary drains, verify KV cache warmup, then proceed in waves. Will post live updates here.
Maria: Can we get a Redwood Console banner + status page blip? Ill push a short customer notice to #customer-status and tag pinned tenants. :calendar:
OpsLead: Drafted status blurb: "Planned maintenance: transient latency increase and temporary routing changes. No customer data impact." Keep messaging conservative.
Sahana: Ops checklist: disable cluster-autoscaler during each drain step to avoid churn. Add this to the runbook prep steps.
Tom: KV warmup recommendation: scale warmup deployment before each ramp and run /warmup against top prefixes. Example: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/backfill-warmup --replicas=20
# curl https://warmup-service.internal/warmup?top=200
```
OpsLead: Add warmup step after canary validation. Also monitor per-route token rates for spikes.
Infra-Oncall: Any Dedicated tenants pinned to specific GPU IDs we must exclude? I can gather pin list and annotate excludes.
OpsLead: Two tenants pinned in us-west-2c. Exclude node label "dedicated:tenant-omega". Ill update the runbook exclude list.
k8s-deploy-bot: Reminder: if not acked, cordon/drain jobs will start at 02:10 UTC.
sre-bot: Event created: gpu-backfill-2026-03-24. Pager duty assigned to Infra-Oncall.
Tom: After warmup run a quick canary loadcheck: `wrk -t4 -c100 -d60s https://canary-api.redwood/v1/generate` to validate KV hit-rate and p50/p99.
Sahana: Temporarily relax SLO alert thresholds 02:00-04:30 UTC to avoid noisy paging; set a 30min grace window post-drain. Postmortem if error-rate > 2x baseline.
OpsLead: Confirmed: SLO overrides configured 02:00-04:30 UTC. Post-action: collect perf histograms and correlate with model variants. Use postmortem template if threshold breached.
Infra-Oncall: Acknowledged. Ill run a small preflight at 23:30 UTC tonight and post the results. Will update this thread during the window with timestamps and decisions. :mag:
OpsLead: Thanks. Runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-backfill-2026-03-24 — follow the prep checklist and keep responses short in this thread; DM if extra hands needed.
